facts.fact: 独居晨间仪式：咖啡、报纸、Radio 4。
facts.anchor: Gloria Jessop carried her cup of coffee to the sofa. Bathed in a neat pool of morning sunlight beneath the sitting room window, the cushions were spotless, inviting. This was the ritual she allowed herself on the days she wasn’t in York. She would eat her oats and fruit at the breakfast table while listening to Radio 4, then make herself an espresso using the fancy machine Jack convinced her to buy. Twenty minutes with the newspaper before she started work, that was her treat, her ‘me time’, as it was called in the lifestyle supplements.
